7.2.2 Pseudonym Management
[CP_SWS_CnV2xSec_00011]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: CP_SRS_CnV2X_00605, CP_SRS_CnV2X_00606
⌈The pseudonym certificate shall be updated to protect the privacy of the user once
the following condition is met: the pseudonym certificate is used for more than 300
seconds, except that the distance is less than 2.1 km or at least one vehicleEventFlags
is in the set state.⌋
[CP_SWS_CnV2xSec_00012]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: CP_SRS_CnV2X_00606
⌈The CnV2xSec shall get time via a call to CnV2xMsg_GetRefTimePtr.⌋

⌈The CnV2xSec shall inform CnV2xMsg to change the pseudonym certificate via

pseudonym certificate change.⌋
